offering_description.value: Runs online auctions for salvage and used vehicles, connecting insurers and other vehicle sellers with dismantlers, rebuilders, dealers and individual buyers.

primary_products.value: Salvage vehicles; used vehicles sold from owned inventory

primary_services.value: Online vehicle auctions; vehicle remarketing; vehicle collection and storage; title processing

items.detail: Insurers, vehicle dealers, fleet operators, dismantlers, recyclers and vehicle rebuilders
Individuals selling vehicles and eligible individuals buying auction vehicles

end_markets.value: Automotive insurance; used vehicles; automotive repair and rebuilding; vehicle dismantling and recycling

items.detail: Buyers and sellers pay fees associated with vehicle auctions
Vehicle collection, storage, title processing and related remarketing services
Buyer memberships that provide auction participation privileges
Resale of vehicles purchased into owned inventory in certain markets
Connects vehicle sellers with commercial and individual buyers through online auctions
Collects, stores and processes sellers' vehicles for auction
Operates vehicle storage yards that support auction and remarketing services
Purchases and resells used and salvage vehicles in certain markets

geography_served.detail: Operations across North America, Europe, Brazil and the Middle East, with an international buyer base

company_size.value: Large international auction operator with an extensive vehicle yard network and a broad commercial buyer base

specialization.detail: Salvage and used vehicle auctions with related collection, storage and title processing services

items.detail: Proprietary website and mobile auction platform
Direct relationships with insurers, dealers and fleet sellers
Vehicle yards provide inspection, collection and pickup access
Registered brokers facilitate purchases for buyers who need licensing assistance

regulatory_exposure.detail: Vehicle auction and dealer licensing, salvage title requirements, and environmental rules for vehicle storage yards; overseen by motor vehicle and environmental authorities

notes: No website text was supplied; descriptions reflect model knowledge, and geographic coverage, fees and licensing requirements vary by market.
